data.name: Asok
data.gender_notes: Asok is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asok means 'without sorrow' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the Ashoka tree, which symbolizes strength, courage, and resilience. In Hindu mythology, Asoka was the name of a great emperor known for his wisdom, kindness, and conquest of the entire Indian subcontinent. The name Asok carries the meaning “Without sorrow” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asok usually hope their child will grow to embody without sorrow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace and emotional strength.
data.etymology: Asok belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Without sorrow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asok total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Asok is a name deeply rooted in Indian history, literature, and folklore. The name inspires a sense of strength, perseverance, and power, inspired by the Asoka tree as well as the great emperor of the same name. The name is often seen as a reference to an individual who embodies these qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: Asok is a name that infuses a sense of inner peace and happiness. It is believed that those bearing this name have a deep inner strength and resilience, and are capable of weathering any emotional or spiritual hardships. Furthermore, Asoka was also known for his wisdom and compassion, making it a name that embodies a seeker of spiritual growth and wisdom. The name Asok invites one to live a life free of sorrow and filled with joy, peace, and inner strength.
